{{Quote|The droids. The blasted feral droids.|Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], enraged at the slaughter of his scientists and technicians in his secret lab|<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
The '''feral droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that&mdash;according to legend&mdash;would kill [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. This legend would be proven true by [[Jax Pavan]] and his band of friends. The deranged machines resided in and near a [[Factory District droid plant|droid plant]] in the [[Factory District]], an abandoned district on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had fallen into disrepair after industry moved to other planets. Mostly older construction and wrecking droids, they had been left behind after the desertion of the district.

==History==
Centuries before Jax Pavan came to the Factory District, it had been abandoned, and around that time, droids began to degenerate into a feral state. Many were [[Battle in the Factory District|destroyed]] when [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] lab, which was in the [[Factory District droid plant|droid plant]] many of the feral droids resided in, exploded. Many droids probably survived as well, and also probably continued to haunt the Factory District.

==Appearance==
[[File:ASPlabordroid-NEGTD.png|thumb|right|200px|Some [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP droids]] were known to be feral.]]
Feral droids could look like anything, because that term described any droid in the Factory District that would kill a sentient being. However, some of the [[BXL-99 labor droid]]s that Jax Pavan encountered had modified themselves in unusual ways. One had [[Plasticine]] tubing with multicolored fluids added inside it, another had lights that ran up and down its arms and blinked on and off randomly, and the third had tall, thin vanes protruding from its head that ran electric discharges between each arm. All had antiquated electronic devices welded to them at seemingly indiscriminate spots.

==Behavior==
Droids that became feral would attack any sentient being, and output random [[Binary/Legends|Binary]]. They appeared to destroy random machinery, including Xizor's lab. They would literally rip apart sentients; they did this in the lab, beheading a [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] scientist, and splattering [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] blood all over the walls.

===Theories on behavior===
The most popular theory on the droids behavior was a worm or virus that had transformed their core programming and turned them into slaughtering monsters. The sentient droid [[I-5YQ]] theorized that extended exposure to the radiation of Xizor's lab's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] had driven them mad.

==List of droids observed to be feral==
*[[8D smelter droid|8D]] smelting operators
*[[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series droids]]
*[[BXL-99 labor droid]]s
*[[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drones]]
